tweaks.name: DISABLE USB POWER SAVING
tweaks.description: Stops USB root hub power management to maintain consistent peripheral connectivity.
tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT 2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3 48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226 2>&1; if ($r -match 'Current AC Power Setting Index: 0x00000000') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

tweaks.name: USB DMA PROTECTION

tweaks.name: DISABLE SLEEP MODE

tweaks.name: DISABLE HIBERNATION

tweaks.name: PIN CURRENT WINDOWS VERSION
tweaks.description: Locks feature updates to the Windows version installed right now (read at apply time). New builds stop being offered until you unpin.

apply.script:
@echo off
for /f "tokens=2,*" %%a in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion" /v DisplayVersion 2^>nul ^| findstr /i DisplayVersion') do set "ATOMVER=%%b"
if not defined ATOMVER for /f "tokens=2,*" %%a in ('reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion" /v ReleaseId 2^>nul ^| findstr /i ReleaseId') do set "ATOMVER=%%b"
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate" /v TargetReleaseVersion /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate" /v TargetReleaseVersionInfo /t REG_SZ /d "%ATOMVER%" /f
exit /b %errorlevel%

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'; $t = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'TargetReleaseVersion' -ErrorAction Stop).TargetReleaseVersion; $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'TargetReleaseVersionInfo' -ErrorAction Stop).TargetReleaseVersionInfo; $cur = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion').DisplayVersion; if ($t -eq 1 -and $v -eq $cur) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

apply.script: $s=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); $e=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddDays(35).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); reg add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings' /v PauseFeatureUpdatesStartTime /t REG_SZ /d $s /f; reg add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings' /v PauseFeatureUpdatesEndTime /t REG_SZ /d $e /f; reg add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings' /v PauseQualityUpdatesStartTime /t REG_SZ /d $s /f; reg add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings' /v PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime /t REG_SZ /d $e /f; reg add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings' /v PauseUpdatesExpiryTime /t REG_SZ /d $e /f

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $e = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings' -Name 'PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime' -ErrorAction Stop).PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime; $d = [datetime]::Parse($e); $n = Get-Date; if ($d -gt $n -and $d -lt $n.AddDays(60)) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\UsoSvc" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
sc start UsoSvc >nul 2>&1
exit /b 0

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $s = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\UsoSvc' -Name 'Start' -ErrorAction Stop).Start; if ($s -eq 4) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

tweaks.name: DISABLE UPDATE MEDIC (WAASMEDICSVC)
tweaks.description: Stops the service whose job is to repair Windows Update back to health - the piece that often re-enables everything above. Undo restores manual start.

apply.script:
@echo off
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WaaSMedicSvc" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
sc stop WaaSMedicSvc >nul 2>&1
exit /b 0

tweaks.check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $s = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\WaaSMedicSvc' -Name 'Start' -ErrorAction Stop).Start; if ($s -eq 4) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
